description: A complete first-pass screen of a Texas site for a data center, battery, generator or industrial load in one call: likely utility and load zone, nearest substations by kV, transmission lines, planned grid upgrades, ERCOT generation and storage queue crowding, 30-day wholesale prices at the load zone and nearest node (average, TB4 spread), gas pipelines within 5 miles, jurisdiction (county, city limits, ETJ estimate, school district, groundwater district), Qualified Opportunity Zone (now and 2027), FEMA flood zone, mapped wetlands and USFWS critical habitat, railroads between the site and its substation, industrial neighbors and recent air permits, and parcel coverage. Ends with a flags list (strengths and risks) and a 0-100 screening score with stated weights. Use when someone asks 'is this a good site', 'screen this location', or wants the full picture before a site visit. Enterprise feature (approved accounts). Free and Pro get the score, flag counts, county, load zone and nearest substation; the flags and weights are Enterprise; the landowner is on Enterprise Lite through parcel_owner.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

to_lat.description: Optional second point (e.g. a planned substation pad or a named POI) to test rail crossings against, instead of the nearest substation.

to_lng.description: Longitude of the optional second point.

use.description: Intended use; shifts the flags and score weights. Default data_center.

name: site_screen
title: One-call site screen
